# A test reaching into a component the one under test builds at run time --
# here one under an `if` over state -- names no one instance on a target that
# keeps state per instance, and is refused at the read. bubbletea keeps no
# state of an instance's own, so it splices the component where it is written
# and the read is the splice's; the interpreter reads the instance it mounted.

! sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:21:15: `#b` is built at run time on this target, so there is no one instance whose hits a test can reach'

! sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:21:15: `#b` is built at run time on this target'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component bar node {
    var hits = 0
    button #btn(text="go", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
    })
}

component main node {
    var show = true
    vbox {
        if show {
            bar #b
        }
    }
}

func testReachesARuntimeInstance(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/main/1 --
sha256:59f23aef6c67d9798d476dba7b99f0cc
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "ReachesARuntimeInstance",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
